overview.text: Abby Veltman is a reading interventionist. She proposes focusing on student learning, using data to strengthen programs, and giving teachers and principals a meaningful role in curriculum decisions. She wants to expand art and music offerings and strengthen the specialized programs that attract families to the district. She says she advocated for reopening the Monrovia High School pool and that it succeeded through city-school district collaboration. She wants to seek more such partnerships for the schools.
